nodes.name: Daily 10AM
nodes.notes: 4.1.3.1: roz 10AM ek baar re-engagement batch check karta hai (calling-hours jaisa SMS ke liye bhi decent-hour rule).

parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM clients_master
WHERE sms_opt_out = false
  AND COALESCE(active_sequence_suppressed, false) = false
  AND phone IS NOT NULL AND phone <> ''
  -- 16.4 rule: SIRF warm/consented relationship -- kabhi cold/first-touch SMS nahi
  AND (
    status IN ('Onboarded', 'Active', 'Churn Risk')
    OR last_reply_channel = 'sms'
  )
  AND (last_sms_sent_at IS NULL OR last_sms_sent_at < now() - interval '90 days')
  AND (updated_at < now() - interval '30 days')  -- inactive-lead threshold
LIMIT 50;

nodes.name: Fetch Re-engagement Candidates
nodes.notes: 4.1.3.1 (Inactive-lead filter): scope sirf warm/consented list tak — cold leads is query se kabhi nahi aayenge, jaisa tracker §16.4 mein explicitly instruct kiya gaya hai. '90 days'/'30 days' thresholds ⚠️ INPUT NEEDED — abhi reasonable default hai, tumhare actual re-engagement cadence se confirm karo.

nodes.name: IF Not Suppressed (safety re-check)
nodes.notes: §16.4 standard: har outbound send-node ke pehle explicit suppression IF-check honi chahiye, sirf query-filter par depend nahi karna — is se agar koi doosra module beech mein opt-out update kare to bhi race-condition safe rahega.
